input.command: cd /workspace && ls -la dotenv tests && git log --oneline -5 2>/dev/null; git status 2>/dev/null | head -20
cd /workspace && cat dotenv/version.py; ls .yecoding; cd /workspace && python -m unittest discover -s tests -v 2>&1 | tail -30
cd /workspace && grep -rn "original.line\|\.line\b" dotenv/ | grep -v parser.py | head -20
cd /workspace && python -m unittest discover -s tests -v 2>&1 | tail -20

cd /workspace && python - <<'EOF'
import io
from dotenv.parser import parse_stream
cases = {
 "LF": "X=1
Y=2
Z=3
",
 "CRLF": "X=1
Y=2
Z=3
",
 "CR": "X=1Y=2Z=3",
 "mixed": "A=1
B=2
C=3
",
 "blank": "A=1

B=2

C=3",
 "multiline quoted": 'A="x
y"
B=2
',
 "trailing no eol": "A=1
B=2",
 "comment": "# c
A=1
# d
B=2
",
}
for name, text in cases.items():
    rows = list(parse_stream(io.StringIO(text)))
    print(name, [(r.key, r.original.line, r.original.string) for r in rows])
EOF
cd /workspace && git diff 2>/dev/null || diff -u <(echo) dotenv/parser.py | head; sed -n '50,58p' dotenv/parser.py
cd /workspace && sed -n '50,58p' dotenv/parser.py && python -m unittest discover -s tests -v 2>&1 | tail -4
